plan: A robot support who grabs an enemy with his hook and pulls them into the middle of his team.
aSurveiller: His Q (Rocket Grab). He grabs the first enemy hit and pulls them to him: always keep a minion between him and you.
contrer: Stay behind your minions: the grab (Q) stops on the first one hit.
His grab has a long cooldown: after a miss, it's time to attack.
Keep a shield or an escape spell: if he grabs you, his E knocks you up right after.
forces: One successful grab can cost anyone their life.
Automatic shield when he's low on health.
His R breaks shields and silences.
faiblesses: Not very useful when his grab is on cooldown.

sorts.P: Shield when he is low on health.
sorts.Q: Hook that grabs and pulls the first enemy hit.
sorts.W: Gains a lot of speed, then is slowed.
sorts.E: His next attack knocks the target up.
sorts.R: Breaks shields and silences nearby enemies.

momentFort: Dangerous from level 2 in lane (grab then punch), and at any point of the game.
